critical_code_review_comments: CookMode.jsx: navigator.wakeLock request is fine but the `released` local flag in the useEffect cleanup is set and never read - dead code, safe to remove.

RecipeCard.jsx substitution match uses exact case-insensitive equality on trimmed strings; if the LLM emits a slightly different spelling (accents, plural) the hint will silently not show. Consider a normalised/loose match or fallback rendering the substitution as a standalone list entry.

server.py scale_recipe.norm(): treats any portion starting with '6' as 6.0 which is correct for '6+', but future portion values like '60' would misroute; consider explicit mapping of the allowed PORTIONS set.
